name: 夕阳再现
group_note: 夕阳再现 之 「风云再起Ⅱ」 -- the original base of the 夕阳三-炎龙美化版 (xysylmhb) family; near-identical logind.lpc/master.lpc/registration flow, no Tomud '2060' handshake gate on the standard port (a separate TOMUD_PORT check in master.lpc's connect() sets a temp flag that logind.lpc only checks if set, so the regular telnet-equivalent port skips it entirely). WASM pass caught proactively via scripts/lib_bulk_fix.py + scripts/scan_known_bugs.py before the first boot test: (1) an uptime()<30 startup-grace gate (AGENTS.md §1.3(e), same pattern as xyxyutf8/etc) -- bypassed for loopback connections. (2) The standard §8.1 check_legal_name() i%2 parity gate/[i..<0] suffix slice (is_chinese() itself already correct) fixed to per-codepoint name[i..i]. (3) master.lpc's valid_read()/valid_write() lacked a 'user == this_object()' short-circuit (this lib already had a partial previous_object()-based guard, like xysylmhb -- added the standard guard alongside it for consistency). httpd.lpc/dns_master.lpc already commented out of preload (pre-existing, dormant) -- left as-is. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (SECURITY_D correctly points at securityd.lpc which genuinely reads WIZLIST; an alternate securd path in globals.h is commented out, no §7.56 ambiguity). Registration verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: English id -> y (confirm new character) -> Chinese name -> admin password + confirm -> login password + confirm -> gift-stat menu (0 for random, y to accept) -> email -> gender (m/f) -> enters world at 客店, look/score both clean. Admin permission confirmed via '★ 您目前权限：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 14000 .lpc files (13888 written, 75 pre-existing unterminated-string/textblock content-file errors left unformatted -- the messiest codebase in this batch so far -- 37 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits; the same 2 case-label-with-trailing-comment hits as xysylmhb (cmds/bakcmds/csc.lpc, cmds/bakcmds/meskills.lpc, dead backup-command copies) diff-reviewed clean. Post-formatter re-verified clean, admin permission still (admin).
